title: Receive and review PCS orders
Schedule appointment with base Transportation Office (TMO/DMO)
Submit DD Form 2278 for PPM (personally procured move) approval
Get weight tickets plan: locate certified scales at origin and destination
Request copies of orders (10+) for lodging, rentals, and reimbursements
Update DEERS with upcoming address change
Notify current landlord / base housing of intent to vacate
Start destination housing search (on-base waitlist + off-base rentals)
Get U-Haul / truck rental quotes for PPM
Price tow equipment (tow dolly vs auto transport)
Build PCS budget and confirm G2 fund target covers out-of-pocket costs
Schedule household goods pack-out / pickup date if using government move
Book pet travel arrangements and health certificates if applicable
Schedule medical and dental records transfer
Request school records / transcripts for dependents
Service both vehicles before the drive (oil, tires, brakes)
Confirm auto insurance coverage in destination state
Reserve hotels along the travel route
Purchase moving materials (boxes, tape, blankets, straps)
Schedule utility disconnects at origin
Schedule utility connects at destination
Submit mail forwarding request with USPS
Update address with banks, credit cards, and loan servicers
Pay off or schedule payments for bills due during travel window
Get empty weight ticket for truck and towed vehicle
Complete base housing move-out inspection
Check out with current command (detaching endorsement)
Get loaded weight ticket after packing the truck
Check in with gaining command
Submit PPM claim packet with all weight tickets and receipts
Submit DLA claim
Update DEERS and MyPay with new address
Set aside 22% of PPM profit for taxes
